skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Beach Guard GT003
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Beach Guard Series GT003. Made with materials that are both durable and comfortable, this outfit ensures high performance in a variety of different conditions.
skins.quote: A seaside trip requires a speedboat, and a boat requires a trustworthy engineer. He's ready and waiting, so just say the word.

skins.name: Empty Crown
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Empty Crown. Outfit Stainless tailored for himself. With unique armor designs and bold weapon modifications, he has successfully recreated the image of a heroic knight in his heart.
skins.quote: Stainless hesitatingly told his granny that he made these clothes 'all in his own time' with 'scrap materials'. Catherine didn't scold him, though. All she said was that his craftsmanship was still a bit shoddy.
